MDG.note: The notice concerns an ID deduplication system, not a business register.

facts.fact: The PRODIGY project, IDA-financed, issued a tender on 29 March 2024 for a turnkey IDMS solution for the deduplication and management of unique identity in Madagascar, proposals due 29 April 2024.

MDG.note: The notice tenders an identity deduplication system and does not say it is or serves as a population register.
